bcg.remark: Albanian calendar (ISHP, October 2022): at birth. Available from 1960: the vaccination programme in Albania was established in 1960 and BCG was produced locally (Epidemiology, Biostatistics and Public Health article on adverse events following immunization in Albanian children).

hepb.remark: Albanian calendar: at birth. Available from 1998: WHO immunization data portal, vaccine introduction data (Albania, hepatitis B birth dose).

penta.remark: Albanian calendar: DTP-HepB-Hib at 2, 4 and 6 months. Available from 2009: WHO immunization data portal, vaccine introduction data (Albania, Hib, which Albania gives in the pentavalent vaccine).

ipv.remark: WHO immunization data portal, vaccine schedule data (2025 snapshot), Albania: IPV at 2 and 4 months only (the 2 and 6 year doses are OPV, see bopv). Available from 2014: WHO immunization data portal, vaccine introduction data (Albania, IPV).

bopv.remark: Albanian calendar: bOPV at 6 months and IPV/bOPV at 2 and 6 years; WHO immunization data portal, vaccine schedule data (2025 snapshot), Albania: OPV at 6 months, 2 years and 6 years. Available from 1960: OPV was part of the programme from its start in 1960 and was imported (Epidemiology, Biostatistics and Public Health article on adverse events following immunization in Albanian children); earlier OPV formulations are not distinguished.

rota.remark: Albanian calendar: Rota-1, 2 and 3 at 2, 4 and 6 months; WHO immunization data portal, vaccine schedule data (2025 snapshot), Albania: 3-dose pentavalent rotavirus vaccine (RV5). Available from 2019: WHO immunization data portal, vaccine introduction data (Albania, rotavirus).

pcv.remark: Albanian calendar: PCV at 2, 4 and 12 months. Available from 2011: WHO immunization data portal, vaccine introduction data (Albania, PCV).

dtp.remark: Albanian calendar: DTP at 2 years. Available from 1960: DTP was produced locally from the start of the programme in 1960 (same article).

mmr.remark: Albanian calendar: FRP (measles, rubella, mumps) at 12 months and 5 years. Available from 2005: WHO immunization data portal, vaccine introduction data (Albania, mumps 2005; measles and rubella second doses from 2001).

dt.remark: Albanian calendar: DT at 6 years. Available from 1960: programme start in 1960; no vaccine-specific year found.

hpv.remark: Albanian calendar: HPV at 13 years. Available from 2022: WHO immunization data portal, vaccine introduction data (Albania, HPV).

code.display: Td (adult), 5 Lf tetanus toxoid, preservative free, adsorbed

td.remark: Albanian calendar: Td at 13 years and at 18-19 years. Available from 1960: programme start in 1960; no vaccine-specific year found.
